entries.geminiText: Careful, Potter. I might start thinking you enjoy my company.

entries.text: Were you waiting for me to speak first?

entries.text: My attention isn't free, you know.
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-2); chosen by Claude

entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-2); chosen by Claude

entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-2); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Well, Potter? Out with it.

entries.text: Staring is unbecoming.
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-2); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Oh! You startled me.

entries.text: I... was thinking.

entries.text: About time, Potter.

entries.text: Not that I needed to hear from you.
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Well. You finally remembered I was here.
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: If you insist on speaking, I suppose I can listen.
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Hardly the worst distraction, I suppose.
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: A few words from you won't ruin my day.
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Only because it's you, mind.
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: You may speak. I happen to be in a charitable mood.
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Whatever is going through that head of yours?
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Why do you find me so impossible to ignore?
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Are your own thoughts that dull, Potter?
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Do you speak to everyone like this, or just me?
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Trying to work me out, are you?
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Have you any idea what you actually want?
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Just what were you hoping to hear from me?
entries.authorship: Gemini 3.8 Flash High via AGY, 12 October 2026 (job gemini-talk-lines-3); chosen by Claude

entries.text: Riveting.
